clusters.name: release-publish
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 defines the manifest/latest contract that US-002 wires into the manual Step 5 and CI workflow; serialize within the cluster (US-002 dependsOn US-001). The cluster's release/CI files do not overlap the installer or docs clusters.

clusters.name: installer-scripts
clusters.executionModeRationale: install.ps1 and the Unix stub touch disjoint new files from the other clusters. The dependsOn release-publish is a data/contract dependency only (US-003 consumes the manifest/latest shape), not a file overlap, so it can author in parallel once the contract section is fixed.

clusters.name: endpoint-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-005 (/latest contract + optional Worker) needs the manifest/latest from release-publish; US-006 docs the real install steps from installer-scripts. Both land in phase 2 after the scripts exist so docs describe real behavior; disjoint files from the other clusters.
